steps.title: Analyze User Request
steps.description: Examine loader overlay and Floating Action Button visibility constraints to resolve FAB overlapping the startup screen.

steps.title: Locate Main Layout XML File
steps.description: Inspect and prepare the main layout file containing the floating plus button and the loading screen overlay.

steps.title: Update Floating Action Button Initial Visibility
steps.description: Configure the android:visibility attribute of the Add Note Button (btn_add_note) to 'gone' in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Trace Loader Lifecycle in MainActivity
steps.description: Ensure the startup loader sequence correctly manages UI view properties in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Visibility Toggle in Loader Handler
steps.description: Add explicit logic to set btn_add_note to GONE inside onCreate and to VISIBLE inside the transition animator complete callbacks.

steps.title: Verify Fade-out Animation Callback
steps.description: Confirm the AnimatorListenerAdapter accurately makes the Add Note Button visible once the loader overlay completely fades out.

steps.title: Validate Sound Synthesizer with New View States
steps.description: Ensure AudioTrack dynamic pitch synthesizers function perfectly alongside the revised loader flow state machine.

steps.title: Test Search and Spinner Interactivity with FAB Hidden State
steps.description: Ensure user experience interactions behave smoothly while the Add Note Button remains hidden.

steps.title: Verify Metadata Integration Consistency
steps.description: Validate package structure, app names, and metadata match perfectly with the user specifications.

steps.title: Building Notes Manager
steps.description: Initiate final compilation and deployment validation check.
